sentences.text: Today we will talk about Tejana in Colombia.
Part one introduction.
Cartajana is a beautiful city in Colombia.
It is next to the Caribbean Sea.
Cartajana is very popular with tourists.
It is famous for its colorful houses, historic walls, and warm weather.
The city is also known as Cartajana de Indias.
Part two history.
Cartajana has a long history.
It was founded by the Spanish in 1533.
In the past the city was very important for trade.
It was also a target for pirates.
That is why Cartajana has big stone walls and forts.
The most famous fort is Castillo San Felipe de Barajas.
It is one of the largest forts in South America.
Today Cartajana is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Part three.
Nature and beaches.
Cartajana has many beautiful beaches.
The sea is blue and clear.
You can swim, relax, and enjoy the sun.
Close to Cartajana, there are the Rosario Islands.
These islands are famous for their white sand and coral reefs.
Many people go there for boat trips.
Cartajana is also close to mangrove forests.
You can take a canoe and explore the quiet nature.
Part four.
Food in Cartajana, the food is delicious.
People eat fresh seafood like fish, shrimp, and crab.
A popular dish is ceviche.
It is made with raw fish, lemon juice, onion, and herbs.
People also enjoy arepas, a type of cornbread.
Another popular snack is empanadas.
Small fried pastries with meat or cheese.
Fresh fruit is everywhere.
You can drink mango juice, coconut water, or passion fruit juice.
On the streets, women called palanqueras wear colorful dresses.
They sell fruit like pineapple, papaya, and watermelon.
Part five.
Culture.
Cartajana has a very rich culture.
The city has music, dance, and festivals.
A famous dance is Cumbia, which comes from Colombia.
You can hear lively Caribbean music in the streets.
People in Cartajana love to dance and celebrate.
Cartajana is also full of art.
The streets have many colorful murals and paintings.
There are also markets where you can buy handmade crafts.
Cartajana is a mix of Spanish, African, and Caribbean traditions.
Part six.
Festivals.
Cartajana is famous for its festivals.
One of the biggest is the Independence Day Festival in November.
There are parades, costumes, music, and street parties.
Another festival is the Hay Festival in January.
Writers, artists, and musicians from all over the world come to Cartajana.
They share books, ideas, and performances.
Cartajana also celebrates Holy Week in April.
There are beautiful processions and traditions in the old city.
These festivals make Cartajana lively and full of energy.
Part seven.
Daily life.
In daily life, people in Cartajana are friendly and relaxed.
They like to spend time outside.
Many people meet in the plazas or squares to talk and enjoy music.
Children play in the streets and families go for walks in the evening.
Life is slower near the sea and people enjoy the warm nights.
Part eight.
Fun facts.
Cartajana is sometimes called the jewel of the Caribbean.
The old city is full of bright yellow, blue, and pink houses.
Famous writer Gabriel Garcia Marquez lived in Cartajana.
Many movies and TV shows were filmed in Cartajana.
The city has both modern skyscrapers and old colonial streets.
That is all for today.
Now you know many things about Cartajana, Colombia.
It is a city with history, beaches, food, culture, and festivals.
Thank you for listening to Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
